svg.text: Ratings tell ideophones from prosaic words; guessing doesn’t.
The two measures see different things — ρ ≈ +.44 overall, +.65 within ideophones (McLean, Dunn & Dingemanse 2023).
McLean, Dunn & Dingemanse (2023), Two measures are better than one — the 304-item backdrop, data CC BY 4.0. · Paulsson (2026), MA thesis — the study this arena replicates (30 pairs, 36 participants).
